summary: Lets Metro give up about 361 feet of old six-inch water main, one sewer manhole and easements, and accept about 364 feet of new eight-inch water main, one fire hydrant assembly, one sewer manhole and easements at 110 Tune Airport Drive. The text says this has no cost to Metro.

judge.problem: Summary says Metro will 'give up' the old water main, manhole and easements, but the text says Metro abandons them. More importantly it frames it loosely; the core accuracy is fine, but 'give up' is not the same as abandonment of public infrastructure/easements. Otherwise quantities match.
